title: Spring Boot
blurb: From 'what is a framework?' to production Spring Boot 3: the container, dependency injection, AOP, web and REST, data access, transactions, Spring Data, testing, security and interview preparation. Every mechanism is modelled in runnable Python so you can watch it work.

modules.summary: What a framework is, what Spring is for, the ecosystem, and a first project with and without Boot.

lessons.title: What a framework is and why Spring exists
The Spring ecosystem and your first project
